-- Local Helpdesk policy relations, copied from the V5 physical candidate (not a Flyway migration).
-- Kept outside test fixtures for offline provisioning; includes private SECURITY INVOKER
-- integrity triggers only. Do not load Stage 6 guarded SQL entrypoints for this Java runtime.

CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards (
    tenant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(btrim(tenant_id)) > 0),
    acl_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (acl_revision >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships (
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards(tenant_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(actor_id)) > 0),
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, actor_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_registry (
    resource_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(resource_type)) > 0),
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(resource_id)) > 0),
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards(tenant_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    owner_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(owner_actor_id)) > 0),
    lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('ACTIVE', 'TOMBSTONED')),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    tombstoned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (resource_type, resource_id),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, owner_actor_id)
        REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships(tenant_id, actor_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK ((lifecycle = 'ACTIVE' AND tombstoned_at IS NULL)
        OR (lifecycle = 'TOMBSTONED' AND tombstoned_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (tombstoned_at IS NULL OR tombstoned_at >= created_at)
);

CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_acl (
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN (
        'workflow:create', 'workflow:activate', 'workflow:transition', 'workflow:read'
    )),
    granted BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id, actor_id, operation),
    FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id)
        REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_registry(tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, actor_id)
        REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships(tenant_id, actor_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_definition_bindings (
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards(tenant_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    resource_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(resource_type)) > 0),
    definition_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(definition_id)) > 0),
    definition_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (definition_version >= 0),
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, resource_type, definition_id, definition_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (definition_id, definition_version)
        REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_definitions(definition_id, definition_version)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

-- Policy-admin audit, distinct from V3 Workflow transition_history.
CREATE TABLE "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_policy_audit (
    audit_event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards(tenant_id)
        ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    previous_acl_revision BIGINT,
    resulting_acl_revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_acl_revision >= 0),
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(actor_id)) > 0),
    actor_source_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(actor_source_ref)) > 0),
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(action)) > 0),
    change_set JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(change_set) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(change_set) > 0),
    reason_or_approval_ref TEXT,
    correlation_ref TEXT,
    manifest_digest TEXT,
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, resulting_acl_revision),
    CHECK ((previous_acl_revision IS NULL AND resulting_acl_revision = 0)
        OR (previous_acl_revision IS NOT NULL
            AND previous_acl_revision >= 0
            AND resulting_acl_revision = previous_acl_revision + 1))
);

-- Physical immutability/append-only enforcement, still a TEST-ONLY D2 candidate.
-- This is ONE PRIVATE TRIGGER implementation, not a seventh wf_port_* SQL entrypoint.
-- SECURITY INVOKER and no PUBLIC EXECUTE: runtime SELECT/DML remains denied
-- by the separately reviewed role/grant design, not by these triggers alone.
CREATE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp
AS $stage6$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'TRUNCATE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'protected Stage 6 policy relations cannot be truncated' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'protected Stage 6 policy identities cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'workflow_policy_audit' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy audit is append-only' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'tenant_guards' THEN
            IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
                    OR NEW.acl_revision < OLD.acl_revision THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable tenant key or decreasing ACL revision' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'tenant_memberships' THEN
            IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
                    OR NEW.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.actor_id THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'resource_registry' THEN
            IF NEW.resource_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_type
                    OR NEW.resource_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_id
                    OR NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
                    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
                    OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'TOMBSTONED' AND
                        (NEW.lifecycle <> 'TOMBSTONED'
                         OR NEW.tombstoned_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tombstoned_at)) THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable resource key, tenant or tombstone' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'resource_acl' THEN
            IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
                    OR NEW.resource_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_type
                    OR NEW.resource_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_id
                    OR NEW.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.actor_id
                    OR NEW.operation IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.operation THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACL identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'workflow_definition_bindings' THEN
            IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
                    OR NEW.resource_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_type
                    OR NEW.definition_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_id
                    OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition binding identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$stage6$;

-- Keep identity rows durable. Admin lifecycle changes use UPDATE through guarded
-- policy operations later; no DELETE/TRUNCATE or primary-key rewrites here.
CREATE TRIGGER s6_guards_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_members_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_registry_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_registry
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_acl_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_acl
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_bindings_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_definition_bindings
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_audit_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_policy_audit
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();

CREATE TRIGGER s6_guards_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_members_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_registry_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_registry
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_acl_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_acl
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_bindings_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_definition_bindings
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER s6_audit_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_policy_audit
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard();

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "${flyway:defaultSchema}".stage6_policy_immutability_guard() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_guards,
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".tenant_memberships,
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_registry,
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".resource_acl,
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_definition_bindings,
    "${flyway:defaultSchema}".workflow_policy_audit
FROM PUBLIC;

# Helpdesk local closeout — 2026-10-29

MODE: IMPLEMENT + VERIFY. Local provisioning and isolated HTTP/PostgreSQL checks PASS;
real Keycloak negative/browser replay NOT RUN. PR #74 remains Draft; no push, merge or LIVE change.

## Baseline and provenance

- Worktree: `D:/olp/dxos-browser-integration/.worktrees/helpdesk-browser-e2e`.
- Branch: `integration/helpdesk-browser-e2e-20261029`.
- Implementation baseline HEAD: `7f411174baecbe338700a73b0351be214e7892b4`.
- Initial status: only pre-existing `?? portal-bff/bin/`; preserved. Changes below are local; no remote publication is claimed.
- Read the [pinned Browser E2E note](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/blob/f943d33c7b7c003fc44d0234e4c912f24dcee847/docs/verification/issue53-browser-helpdesk-e2e-20261029.md).
  GitHub GET also confirmed PR #74 open/Draft at `f943d33c7b7c003fc44d0234e4c912f24dcee847`.
  No remote mutation was performed.
- The browser happy path is **operator-observed** evidence from that note. No screenshot,
  browser automation, real SSO negative, or CI run was acquired by this closeout.
- Earlier PostgreSQL 18/18 and backend 110 tests remain earlier local evidence. They are
  not added to the execution counts below or relabeled as CI evidence.

## Root cause and change

The original seed omitted `helpdesk_actors.display_name`; the protected demo actors
had NULL labels. Schema permits this (`backend/src/main/resources/db/helpdesk/schema.sql:9`).
`HelpdeskService.java:210` reads the directory labels, nullable JSON fields are omitted
at lines 43–44, and `frontend/src/features/helpdesk/HelpdeskPortal.tsx:41` supplies the fallback.

Changes are restricted to local provisioning, tests, runner and these instructions:

- `scripts/helpdesk-local-actor-seed.ps1`: emit the existing canonical issuer/sub mapping,
  membership and fixed actor flags. Optional `TrustedDemoRealmFile` supplies names only
  when the loopback issuer realm and all three exact username/subject pairs match the
  trusted demo realm provisioning input. Names come from `firstName` + `lastName`;
  incomplete, ambiguous or mismatched identities fail before any SQL is emitted.
  With no trusted file, labels remain SQL NULL. SQL strings are escaped.
- `scripts/helpdesk-local-setup.ps1`: reuse that seed before resource creation; preserve
  the old parameter positions and existing new-resource-only guard. No existing volume
  or database is reseeded.
- `scripts/test-helpdesk-local-actor-seed.ps1`: seven assert-based checks for names,
  NULL fallback, exact canonical/authority preservation, mismatched subject/realm,
  SQL escaping and ambiguous users.
- `HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest.java:223`: execute the real PowerShell seed against the
  separate PostgreSQL fixture with explicit synthetic realm user IDs, then test detail
  labels, mismatched-subject 404, denied elevation and unchanged list contract. This
  PowerShell integration case is Windows-only; it executed and passed here.
- The synthetic OIDC fixture now uses `/realms/tricore` in its ephemeral issuer path.
  It is not the running Keycloak issuer and is never presented as real Keycloak evidence.
- `HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest.java:724`: extend the existing embedded production app test
  with socket HTTP negatives and database snapshot assertions after denied/duplicate writes.
- `scripts/helpdesk-negative-local.ps1`: guarded creation and execution on a fresh fixture;
  no dependency or production/Core/API/UI implementation change.
- `scripts/README-helpdesk-local.md`: document the trusted-file and isolated-runner usage.

The trust source is the provisioner's original trusted realm input, not a filename-based
trust decision or a verified login. The regression fixture explicitly declares Employee Demo,
Coordinator Demo and Worker Demo with their exact synthetic IDs. No trusted realm export
for the existing live demo was ingested, no current Keycloak profile was queried or changed,
and no name was inferred from a frontend role, username alone or the current DB role flags.

**List contract remains unchanged:** `HelpdeskService.java:261` intentionally omits names
from list/write projections. Provisioned labels are available on detail. Exposing names
in list requires separate contract review. Existing confirmed records retain NULL labels;
retroactive population requires a separate reviewed data fix and was NOT RUN.

## Isolation and protected evidence

Created resources, all distinct from browser/Stage6/staging resources:

| Resource | Observed value |
|---|---|
| Container | `dxos-helpdesk-negative-closeout_20261029_a` |
| Container ID | `ac7e43f33ddecd35dd8bfcb1b5dff0dcb58ba67c08d2d6e5c6475768cc589d60` |
| PostgreSQL | 17.11, image `postgres:17.11-alpine` |
| Host binding | `127.0.0.1:55439 -> 5432/tcp` |
| Database | `helpdesk_disposable_test` |
| New named volume | `dxos-helpdesk-negative-closeout_20261029_a-data` |
| JDBC pin | `jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:55439/helpdesk_disposable_test` |

Preflight checked all existing container/volume names, Docker endpoint, image and free
port. A creation nonce rejects volume reuse/races. Tests create unique schemas/runtime
roles only in this fixture; the existing suite removes its own test schemas/roles afterward
(postcheck: zero `helpdesk_%` schemas). The new container/database/volume remain retained.
No existing container was stopped, restarted, reset, removed or migrated. Before/after
container IDs, startup times, states and restart counts were identical, including Keycloak,
the browser DB, Stage6 and staging containers.

Credential was generated by a CSPRNG, passed over stdin into a mode-600 tmpfs bootstrap
file, and used only through process environment by tests. Docker configuration contains
the password-file path, not the plaintext password. The bootstrap file was removed after
startup; tmpfs metadata and absence were independently checked. No plaintext host/durable secret file,
credential output or credential commit was created. The test admin is confined to this
container; application test connections use the suite's non-superuser runtime role.

Protected request `37941103-fc8b-43e7-920b-34ca35784c2c` in

- Fingerprint over request, instance, ordered history, tenant actors/memberships,

  `b2f93acf81292456963db95f909d97db`.
- No POST, UPDATE or reseed targeted this request or its database. Backend/BFF/Keycloak/
  Caddy at 8080/8081/8182/8443 were not restarted; the test app and JWKS server used
  ephemeral loopback ports.

`backend/build/closeout-closeout_20261029_a/`; no CI result is claimed.

| PowerShell actor provisioning assertions | PASS: 7 | `provisioning.log` |
| HTTP/PostgreSQL suite | PASS: 47; FAIL: 0; SKIP: 1; exit 0 | `http-postgres.log`, `http-postgres-results.json` |
| Frontend focused suites | PASS: 75; exit 0 | `frontend.log` |

| PowerShell parse and `git diff --check` | PASS | `verification-summary.txt` |

Commands executed:

```powershell

pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/helpdesk-negative-local.ps1 -RunId closeout_20261029_a
# Runner: backend/gradlew.bat --no-daemon test --tests '*HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest' --console=plain
# From frontend:
npm.cmd test -- src/services/mvp/helpdeskPresentation.test.ts src/services/mvp/http/sameOriginTransport.test.ts src/features/helpdesk/HelpdeskPortal.test.tsx

.\gradlew.bat -p ..\portal-bff test --rerun-tasks --tests '*PortalSecurityTest' --tests '*PortalBackendClientTest' --console=plain

```

The bundled PowerShell 7 executable was used locally; execution policy override was
process-scoped. No machine/user execution policy was changed. JDK was 21.0.11.
The runner refuses an existing container/volume/port/evidence path; it must not be rerun
against this retained fixture. Review artifacts directly; any fresh fixture needs a
separately free port compatible with the suite's explicit endpoint pin.

| Anonymous/expired token | PASS: socket HTTP 401; snapshots unchanged |

2. Mở `http://127.0.0.1:5173/session`. Có thể dùng viewport desktop 1440 px; mobile 390 px; tablet 834 px.

1. Dashboard: chỉ ra thống kê lấy từ fixtures hiển thị cho vai trò hiện tại, bảng yêu cầu và hoạt động gần đây.
2. Bấm **Tạo yêu cầu mới**, chọn **Hỗ trợ CNTT**. Gửi form trống để thấy validation và focus trường lỗi đầu tiên.
3. Nhập tiêu đề tối thiểu 8 ký tự, mô tả tối thiểu 20 ký tự, vị trí và ưu tiên. Attachments ghi **BLOCKED FEATURE**, không nhận tệp.
4. Gửi: nút có loading/chống gửi trùng, sau đó mở chi tiết và thông báo thành công. Ghi lại mã yêu cầu, thường `DX-1049` ở phiên mới.

6. Mở Bàn xử lý hoặc Yêu cầu của tôi, chọn mã vừa tạo. Phê duyệt → nhập ghi chú → xác nhận. Tiếp tục Bắt đầu xử lý → Hoàn thành, mỗi bước thêm sự kiện timeline. Yêu cầu kết thúc không có thao tác tiếp.

# feat(portal): Layer 2 DX-OS Service Portal (#39)

DX-OS chưa có consumer Tầng 2 có giao diện. PR này thêm portal tiếng Việt build/run độc lập, cho phép trình diễn tạo yêu cầu, phê duyệt/xử lý và lịch sử của IT Support/Facility bằng mock data. **Chỉ hoàn thành mock UI prototype. Issue #39 giữ OPEN; chưa có HTTP end-to-end thật.**

## UI screens

- Phiên demo/đổi vai trò/hết hạn, dashboard, danh sách yêu cầu và form tạo mới.
- Bàn phê duyệt/xử lý, chi tiết yêu cầu, timeline/lịch sử, Integration Status.
- Search không dấu, filter, pagination, validation, loading, empty/error/success.
- Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile, font cục bộ, Lucide, design tokens, focus và reduced motion.

## Architecture

`frontend/` là SPA React + Vite + TypeScript, stack đã được người dùng xác nhận sau audit. Shared `RequestService` interface → composition root → `MockRequestService`. `HttpApiClient` riêng luôn từ chối trước mạng, không có cờ bật LIVE. Không import Java/Core, không nối PostgreSQL, không có credential hoặc trusted identity từ header.

Chỉ thêm source frontend, tests, docs và screenshot evidence; không sửa backend, Core contracts, Gateway/Identity/Workflow, Flyway V1–V4 hoặc PR #35.

## Mock workflows

IT Support và Facility dùng chung request view model, form, table, metadata, action dialog và timeline. Mock chỉ có phản hồi cố định phục vụ UX; không có WorkflowRuntime/definition execution ở frontend. Role/visibility chỉ mô phỏng, không chứng minh backend ACL.

Không tự retry write/transition. Double-submit bị khóa; kết quả ghi chưa xác định vô hiệu hóa gửi tiếp và hướng dẫn kiểm tra lịch sử.

## Build/test results

Local PASS: TypeScript + Vite build; 19 unit/component tests; 12 Playwright Chromium smoke tests; axe WCAG 2 A/AA + 2.1 AA trên tám màn hình và ba viewport dashboard (0 violations); source/bundle credential-pattern scan (27 files). npm install audit: 0 vulnerabilities tại thời điểm cài. Backend tests SKIP vì không sửa backend; real HTTP/security E2E BLOCKED. Không tuyên bố CI đã chạy.

Xem [bằng chứng và lệnh tái hiện](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/blob/feature/issue39-portal-ui/docs/evidence/issue39-portal/README.md).

# DX-OS Internal Service Portal — Issue #39

**MOCK / DEVELOPMENT · Giao diện prototype Tầng 2. Chưa có HTTP end-to-end thật. Issue #39 phải giữ OPEN.**

Ứng dụng SPA độc lập, tiếng Việt, trình diễn hai dịch vụ IT Support và Facility trên cùng components, request view model, service interface và timeline. Không thay đổi Core, Gateway, Identity, Workflow, Flyway V1–V4 hay PR #35.

## Chạy localhost

Yêu cầu Node.js >= 22.12 (đã kiểm tra bằng Node 24.19.0), npm và trình duyệt hiện đại.

```powershell
Set-Location D:\olp\issue39-university-ui\frontend
npm.cmd ci
npm.cmd run dev
```

Mở **http://127.0.0.1:5173**. Trên macOS/Linux dùng `npm` thay cho `npm.cmd`. Không cần backend, database, `.env` hoặc credentials.

```powershell
npm.cmd run build
npm.cmd run preview -- --port 4173
```

Production hosting phải có SPA fallback về `index.html` cho các deep links. Không có deployment trong phạm vi này.

## Stack và cấu trúc

React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript strict, React Router 7, Lucide, Be Vietnam Pro được phục vụ cục bộ, CSS tokens; phiên bản chính xác nằm trong `package-lock.json`. Stack được người dùng xác nhận sau audit. Không tải font, analytics hoặc tài nguyên bên thứ ba khi sử dụng app.

```text
src/
  components/ui.tsx           Shared table, badges, timeline, modal, UI states
  domain/request.ts          Shared view model, labels, validation, filtering
  fixtures/requests.ts        Synthetic demo records for both services
  services/RequestService.ts  UI-facing application service interface
  services/portalService.ts   Composition root: interface -> mock service
  services/MockRequestService.ts  In-memory demo responses and fault controls
  services/HttpApiClient.ts   Closed HTTP boundary; rejects before networking
  hooks/useRequests.ts        Loading, read errors, expired demo session handling
  pages/                     Dashboard, list/history/desk, create, detail, system
  context.tsx                Demo role, success announcements, refresh state
  tokens.css / styles.css    Palette, typography, responsive and reduced motion
tests/portal.spec.ts          Browser smoke, WCAG checks and real screenshots
scripts/check-security.mjs    Source/bundle credential-pattern check
```

MOCK mặc định dùng `RequestService` qua composition root. `HttpApiClient` tách biệt và luôn trả `LIVE_BLOCKED`. APP-10/11/13/14 đã có mapper, Assignment Form, typed HTTP adapter cho chín route candidate PR #63 và Portal feature riêng qua optional `helpdeskService` injection; chỉ kiểm thử bằng fake transport, chưa có concrete LIVE transport, token hay cờ mở LIVE. Không coi view model mock là DTO backend. Xem [kiểm kê MVP và checklist kết nối thật](../docs/application/issue39-mvp-readiness-20261027.md).

Logout, đổi vai trò và 401 vô hiệu hóa kết quả async của phiên cũ. Response muộn không chuyển trang, phát thông báo hay làm hết hạn phiên mới; 401 của phiên hiện tại vẫn kết thúc phiên sau khi rời màn hình. Assignment không bắt đầu GET Detail sau logout. Lệnh ghi đã gửi không bị hủy/replay; unknown outcome của MVP vẫn khóa để chờ đối soát. Đây là vòng đời phiên demo/fake, chưa phải logout hoặc thu hồi phiên OIDC/BFF.

Hai workflow UX dùng chung form, bảng, metadata, action dialog và timeline. Những phản hồi cố định trong mock chỉ phục vụ demo; **không phải frontend Workflow engine**, không thực thi definition, không có BPMN editor, persistence hay orchestration Core. Các thao tác được cho phép thật phải do backend quyết định sau security gate.

## Các màn hình

| Route           | Nội dung                                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/session`      | Vào/kết thúc phiên demo, đổi vai trò, mô phỏng hết hạn; SSO bị chặn |
| `/login`        | Form email/mật khẩu, ghi nhớ riêng email; submit và khôi phục mật khẩu bị chặn |
| `/register`     | Form đăng ký Sinh viên/Giảng viên; không tạo tài khoản hoặc cấp quyền |
| `/`             | Dashboard và truy cập nhanh hai dịch vụ                             |
| `/requests`     | Search không dấu, filter dịch vụ/trạng thái, phân trang             |
| `/requests/new` | Form dùng chung, validation, loading, success/error                 |
| `/approvals`    | Bàn xử lý dành cho vai trò người xử lý mô phỏng                     |
| `/requests/:id` | Chi tiết, phiên bản mock, thao tác xử lý và timeline                |
| `/history`      | Lịch sử từng yêu cầu, mới nhất trước                                |
| `/integration`  | Trạng thái các capability, kiểm tra chặn LIVE và fault controls     |

Loading được mô phỏng với độ trễ 350 ms. Không có kết quả: hướng dẫn đổi bộ lọc. Lỗi đọc có nút tải lại do người dùng chủ động. Form giữ nội dung khi lỗi mạng. Ghi có khóa chống double-submit và không tự retry. Khi `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, UI vô hiệu hóa gửi tiếp và hướng dẫn kiểm tra lịch sử. Lỗi 401 mô phỏng kết thúc phiên và hiển thị thông báo; 403 và hidden/missing 404 có thông báo an toàn. Đây không phải bằng chứng kiểm quyền backend.

## Ranh giới bảo mật và BLOCKED API

| Capability               | Điều kiện còn thiếu                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Identity / SSO           | Verified browser login, OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE, #24                                                                       |
| Gateway / Workflow HTTP  | Registration, resource ACL, tenant binding và security gate #22/#23/#24; mọi create/activate/transition/snapshot/history đều chặn |
| Data persistence         | HTTP application contract được duyệt; không nối PostgreSQL hoặc Java trực tiếp                                                    |
| Attachments              | Backend Storage API có kiểm quyền #26: **BLOCKED FEATURE**, không có file input hoặc upload giả                                   |
| HTTP DTO / error mapping | OpenAPI và review contract #37                                                                                                    |

Không có secret, admin token, service-role key, database credential hay `X-User`/`X-Role` làm nguồn định danh. Chỉ có tên/vai trò demo trong `sessionStorage`; sửa giá trị này không phải chứng minh authentication/authorization. Fixture visibility (nhân viên xem yêu cầu mẫu của mình; người xử lý xem bộ dữ liệu mẫu) chỉ là hành vi UX.

## Kiểm thử

```powershell
npm.cmd run build
npm.cmd test
npx.cmd playwright install chromium
npm.cmd run test:smoke
npm.cmd run check:security
```

Smoke suite khởi chạy production preview tại `127.0.0.1:4173`, kiểm tra hai luồng UI, lỗi/empty/validation, chặn API, keyboard/modal, desktop/tablet/mobile và axe WCAG 2 A/AA + 2.1 AA. Screenshot được tạo trực tiếp từ localhost tại [evidence](../docs/evidence/issue39-portal/README.md). Không dùng ảnh dựng làm bằng chứng. Script security chỉ là kiểm tra mẫu credentials phổ biến, đi kèm review source và staged diff.

Python không có trong môi trường triển khai nên browser suite dùng Playwright TypeScript, có thể chạy bằng dependencies đã khóa của dự án.

## Giới hạn

### Email/mật khẩu: chỉ xem trước giao diện

`/login` và `/register` dùng thương hiệu DX-OS, Be Vietnam Pro và Lucide, bố cục
hai cột trên desktop và một cột trên mobile. Truy cập từ liên kết tại `/session`
hoặc mở trực tiếp URL. Nút **Vào phiên Demo** luôn mở luồng Demo hiện có riêng.

Email, họ tên, độ dài mật khẩu (đăng ký: 12–128 ký tự) và xác nhận mật khẩu được
kiểm tra tại form. Đây là quy tắc UI tạm thời, không phải chính sách Identity đã
được duyệt. Chỉ dùng dữ liệu giả; không nhập mật khẩu thật để thử nghiệm.

Submit hợp lệ chỉ kiểm tra form cục bộ, xóa các ô mật khẩu rồi hiển thị
**BLOCKED FEATURE**. Không gửi HTTP, không tạo JWT, không tạo tài khoản, không
thay đổi vai trò/phiên Demo và không báo đăng nhập thành công. Quên mật khẩu cũng
hiển thị **BLOCKED FEATURE**. Không có endpoint hoặc công tắc mở authentication.
Luồng thật phải do backend Identity xử lý qua API được phê duyệt và bảo vệ.

Chỉ khi người dùng chọn **Ghi nhớ email**, email hợp lệ được lưu trong
`localStorage` dưới khóa `dxos-remembered-email-v1`; bỏ chọn sẽ xóa ngay. Mật khẩu
chỉ tồn tại tạm trong ô nhập và bộ nhớ lúc validation, không được lưu vào browser
storage, fixtures, logs hoặc gửi qua mạng. Đăng ký chỉ có Sinh viên/Giảng viên và
từ chối giá trị vai trò bị sửa thành admin/processor. Không có quyền thực được cấp.

Test mới nằm tại `src/pages/Auth.test.tsx` và `tests/auth.spec.ts`. Xem
[ảnh Login/Register](../docs/evidence/issue39-portal/auth/README.md) ở desktop,
tablet, mobile 390px và 320px. Bộ smoke hiện có tiếp tục kiểm tra tạo yêu cầu,
phê duyệt, xử lý, timeline và `HttpApiClient` fail-closed. Theme chỉ tăng tương
phản một số màu chữ phụ để các kiểm tra WCAG hiện có đạt; không đổi bố cục dashboard.

- Request và lịch sử chỉ ở bộ nhớ trong **một tab**. Reload hoặc khôi phục demo sẽ reset fixtures; đổi route bằng sidebar giữ dữ liệu.
- Phiên demo chỉ lưu lựa chọn vai trò trong tab, không có SSO, access token hay quyền thực.
- Kết quả ghi chưa xác định chỉ là mô phỏng lỗi; mock không xác nhận một commit thật đã xảy ra.
- Chưa kiểm chứng real 401/403/404, cross-tenant denial, concurrency/persistence hoặc HTTP end-to-end.
- Browser coverage hiện là Chromium; axe không thay thế audit accessibility thủ công đầy đủ. Bảng cuộn ngang bên trong ở màn hình nhỏ.
- Chưa upload/read file, chưa gửi thông báo thực, chưa triển khai hosting.

Xem [hướng dẫn demo](DEMO_GUIDE.md). Refs #39; chỉ ghi nhận **mock UI prototype hoàn thành** khi local checks đạt, không đóng Issue #39.

# DX-OS Portal BFF candidate (Y2.2)

Server-side OAuth boundary imported from PR #70 `d833b363d22c1ad30a1f5d7bdc7b3d7712fb7d27`. The integration branch imports the complete `frontend/` tree from PR #71 `c73bbc306a698141169304e5da848ea0686700db`, including its stacked baseline, onto Backend #74 `b6e05d080ebb24b54cc4d61dc4e20e2907fd2eaa`. Only an explicit `integration-local` build connects the Helpdesk Portal to this BFF. Normal builds retain MOCK. LIVE remains blocked; no merge/deployment is authorized.

## Contract

- Serve the built Portal and this BFF through one HTTPS origin. Route `/bff/**`, `/oauth2/authorization/**`, and `/login/oauth2/code/**` to the BFF. Keep the Backend private to the BFF. The BFF process binds to `127.0.0.1`; the trusted HTTPS reverse proxy must reject unknown Host values and strip untrusted forwarding headers.
- Set `PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` to the exact HTTPS origin and `PORTAL_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI` to `${PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN}/login/oauth2/code/keycloak`. Register that exact callback with Keycloak. Use a confidential Authorization Code client with a client secret and logout redirect to `${PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN}/`. PKCE S256 is added to authorization requests.
- Set `PORTAL_OIDC_ISSUER_URI`, `PORTAL_OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, and `PORTAL_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` from a secret manager. The Keycloak access token must contain the Backend's exact issuer, audience, and `resource_access` authority claims; the BFF does not create or rewrite these claims.
- Set `PORTAL_BACKEND_BASE_URL` to the private HTTPS Backend origin, or a literal `127.0.0.1` HTTP origin for a local disposable test. No request header, cookie, or browser token is forwarded. Only the server-held access token becomes an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- `/bff/session` returns `{authenticated:false}` or `{authenticated:true,csrfToken}` with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Browser writes and `POST /bff/logout` must send the token in `X-CSRF-TOKEN`. The cookie is `Secure`, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, host-only, path `/`; Lax permits the top-level OIDC GET callback while CSRF remains enabled.
- `/bff/api/v1/mvp/requests` accepts the nine Helpdesk candidate routes only. Upstream redirects are rejected. Failed writes return `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` without retry; reconcile through an authorized detail/history read.

## Verification and gates

Run `backend/gradlew.bat -p portal-bff test` with JDK 21. Tests cover anonymous/forged-header rejection, the actual CSRF header obtained from `/bff/session`, PKCE, confidential-client enforcement, session response, origin checks, bearer forwarding, hidden 404/409 propagation, redirect refusal, and no write retry. Frontend tests cover the concrete transport and session composition with mocked fetch. These checks do not prove a real Keycloak session, refresh, provider logout, HTTPS ingress, or PostgreSQL persistence.

## Local setup (PowerShell, from the integration worktree root)

1. Use a fresh disposable environment; do not restart or reuse the retained Helpdesk/Keycloak data. In this run, reserve PostgreSQL `127.0.0.1:55442`, RunId `browser_20261029`, and a new Keycloak at `127.0.0.1:8182`. The running containers `dxos-stage6-pg17-local` (50835) and `dxos-olp-staging-postgres-1` (55426) are protected and must not be changed. Use `scripts/README-helpdesk-local.md` with the new RunId/port after the real users exist. Keep Java bound to `127.0.0.1:8080`; seed the three actual users' issuer/sub membership and Helpdesk actors in the new database. No Stage6 SQL, Flyway V1–V4, Facility, or MinIO changes are needed here.

2. In realm `tricore`, provision a **new** OpenID Connect client `dxos-portal-bff-local`: Client authentication ON, Standard flow ON, PKCE S256 required, implicit/direct access grants/service accounts OFF. Require `client_secret_basic`. Exact redirect URI: `https://localhost:8443/login/oauth2/code/keycloak`; exact post-logout URI: `https://localhost:8443/`. No wildcard redirects or browser CORS origins are needed. Supply the generated secret only to the BFF process through environment/secret storage. The application refuses reuse of `tricore-api` and public authentication methods.

3. The new isolated environment uses exactly **`http://127.0.0.1:8182/realms/tricore`**. After manual admin/realm setup, verify discovery returns that exact string and pin **both** `OIDC_ISSUER_URI` and `PORTAL_OIDC_ISSUER_URI` to it. The earlier #74 Postman issuer was `http://127.0.0.1:8180/realms/tricore`; the older `.env.example` uses `localhost:8180`. These are different issuer/identity keys, and their old tokens/actors must not be reused. The new Keycloak container is only created, awaiting the user's manual bootstrap admin step. If using an existing trusted HTTPS issuer, use its exact discovery value on both sides and provision the disposable actors for those identities first; never bypass certificate validation.

   Set Backend `OIDC_AUDIENCE=tricore-api`, `OIDC_RESOURCE_CLIENT_ID=tricore-api`. Attach a client scope to the new BFF client that adds access-token audience `tricore-api` (Audience mapper, included client audience `tricore-api`, access token ON). Keep the client-role mapper producing **`resource_access.tricore-api.roles`**, not BFF-client roles or realm roles. Limit role scope to the required roles: Employee `workflow:create`, `workflow:activate`, `workflow:read`, `workflow:transition`; Coordinator/Worker `workflow:read`, `workflow:transition`. Their distinct DB actor memberships/ACL decide workflow capabilities. Inspect claims server-side without logging tokens. See [Keycloak administration](https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_admin/index.html) for client scopes, audience and role mappers.

4. Build the explicit local composition and run its checks:

   ```powershell
   Push-Location frontend
   npm.cmd ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
   npm.cmd test
   npm.cmd run build:integration-local
   npm.cmd run check:security
   Pop-Location
   ```

   `npm.cmd run build` restores the default MOCK build. Local integration refuses HTTP and non-loopback origins. It reads `/bff/session`, keeps only CSRF in memory, and never reads a demo persona for access. A 401 removes the Helpdesk UI and requires a new login. Unknown writes stay blocked across feature navigation; an authorized detail/history read is for reconciliation, not permission to replay a POST.

5. In a dedicated terminal with JDK 21, start the BFF after providing its secret in the process environment:

   ```powershell
   $env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-21.0.11'
   $env:Path = "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path"
   $env:SERVER_PORT = '8081'
   $env:PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN = 'https://localhost:8443'
   $env:PORTAL_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI = 'https://localhost:8443/login/oauth2/code/keycloak'
   $env:PORTAL_OIDC_ISSUER_URI = 'http://127.0.0.1:8182/realms/tricore'
   $env:PORTAL_OIDC_CLIENT_ID = 'dxos-portal-bff-local'
   $env:PORTAL_BACKEND_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
   if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:PORTAL_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET)) { throw 'Supply the BFF client secret through the process environment first.' }
   .\backend\gradlew.bat -p portal-bff bootRun --console=plain
   ```

6. Install Caddy from its official distribution if absent. From the worktree root, validate and run the supplied loopback-only HTTPS ingress:

   ```powershell
   caddy validate --config .\portal-bff\Caddyfile.local --adapter caddyfile
   caddy run --config .\portal-bff\Caddyfile.local --adapter caddyfile
   # In another terminal, after the local CA exists; trust installation may require elevation:
   caddy trust
   curl.exe --fail https://localhost:8443/bff/session
   ```

   Verify browser trust with no certificate exception before logging in. Caddy's local CA must be trusted by the browser/OS; Java must also trust any HTTPS issuer/backend CA it contacts. The ingress strips untrusted forwarding values, pins forwarded host/protocol, serves SPA fallback, rejects `/api/*`, and routes only BFF/OIDC paths to port 8081. Caddy v2.11.7 was downloaded to the ignored `backend/build/helpdesk-browser-local/tools` directory and checked against its published SHA-512 checksum. Validation succeeded. Verified-CA/hostname HTTPS probes return Portal 200, private `/api/*` 404 and mismatched SNI/Host 421 after adding `strict_sni_host on`. The runtime uses a private CA/storage directory and `install_trust=false`; the user must install its public CA in their browser/OS trust store before browser testing. See [Caddy local TLS/trust](https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile/directives/tls), [proxy headers](https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile/directives/reverse_proxy), and [SNI/Host enforcement](https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile/options).

## Real browser acceptance — NOT RUN / BLOCKED

Docker Desktop 29.7.2 is available. Retained containers/data were not reused. New Keycloak `dxos-helpdesk-browser-keycloak-20261029` and its private volume/network are prepared but not started; bootstrap admin, client provisioning and secrets are deliberately left to the user. PostgreSQL demo preflight for 55442 passed; actual demo setup awaits real user sub values and setup/runtime passwords. HTTPS ingress and the integration-local Portal build run at 8443, but browser trust installation is still pending. Backend/BFF cannot start until those prerequisites exist, so `/bff/session` currently returns 502. No real BFF→Backend session, browser login, disposable full-stack request, or its persistence is verified. Local manual scripts/instructions are prepared in the ignored `backend/build/helpdesk-browser-local/MANUAL-SETUP.md`; none of their admin/secret/trust steps were executed. BFF/frontend unit tests are not browser E2E evidence.

Backend `test --no-daemon --rerun-tasks --console=plain` was rerun on two newly owned PostgreSQL 17.11 fixtures, including verified TLS and wrong-CA/hostname negatives: Gradle exit 0, **999 tests / 992 passed / 7 skipped / 0 failures/errors**. All nine Workflow DB suites passed (196 cases); Helpdesk passed 46 of 47 cases. The 7 remaining skips require real Keycloak tokens: 6 Identity/Gateway cases and B06. These tests hardcode `http://localhost:8180/realms/tricore`, so the new 8182 issuer's tokens cannot be substituted. The original 155 class-disabled entries expand into parameterized cases when enabled; their counts are not one-to-one. A wrapper port-selection error caused an intermediate failed run; it was corrected to use Docker's allocated port, with no source-test or guard changes, before the successful rerun. Logs/JUnit XML are under `backend/build`; unit/fixture tokens are not evidence of a real Keycloak/BFF browser session.

After setup, use three isolated browser profiles/contexts at `https://localhost:8443/mvp/helpdesk` and genuine Keycloak logins. Create a **new disposable** Employee request; record its returned ID without sensitive data. Coordinator performs Triage then Assign using the server's eligible assignees and current versions. Assigned Worker performs Start then Resolve. Employee performs Confirm. Reload detail and GET history through the BFF: final state `CONFIRMED`, version 4, exactly four transitions `triage`, `start_work`, `resolve`, `confirm`; Assign updates assignmentVersion without adding a workflow transition. Restart Java against the same disposable database and verify detail/history again before claiming persistence.

Check anonymous/expired session 401; valid-session missing/wrong CSRF 403; insufficient role/action 403; unauthorized actor/resource detail and history hidden 404; stale workflow/assignment versions 409 with unchanged state/history; disconnected reads; lost write response `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no second POST. Inspect browser traffic/storage to ensure no direct Backend calls or bearer tokens. Also verify cookie `__Host-DXOS-Portal` is Secure/HttpOnly/host-only/SameSite=Lax and that an unknown Host cannot reach the app. Do not mark any of these cases PASS until actually run. Do not merge or enable production/LIVE from this local candidate.

# DX-OS MVP: PostgreSQL local

Chỉ dành cho demo local, chưa bật LIVE. Script tạo **container + named volume mới**,
không sửa/xóa database hay container có sẵn. Mỗi `RunId` chỉ setup một lần;
restart dùng container cũ, không chạy lại setup. Nếu setup lỗi, giữ tài nguyên để kiểm tra;
chọn RunId mới để thử lại sau khi xác định lỗi.

## Prerequisites và credentials

Windows PowerShell 5.1 hoặc PowerShell 7, Docker Desktop Linux Engine local
(`desktop-linux` qua named pipe), JDK 21; cổng PostgreSQL 55440 và HTTP 8080 trống.
Từ thư mục gốc repo, tải image nếu chưa có:

```powershell
docker --context desktop-linux pull postgres:17.11-alpine
$run = 'demo_20261027' # đổi cho mỗi lượt demo mới
$db = 'helpdesk_disposable_' + $run
$container = 'dxos-helpdesk-' + $run
$volume = $container + '-data'
```

`HELPDESK_SETUP_PASSWORD` và `HELPDESK_RUNTIME_PASSWORD`: hai secret khác nhau,
ít nhất 24 ký tự, không có control characters. Script hỏi ẩn nếu chưa đặt trong
process environment. Không gõ password trực tiếp vào command/history, ghi `.env`,
Git, transcript hoặc log. Có thể lấy từ secret manager vào process environment.
Để dùng cùng runtime secret khi khởi động Backend, nhập qua prompt ẩn:

```powershell
$credential = [PSCredential]::new('runtime', (Read-Host 'Runtime password' -AsSecureString))
$env:HELPDESK_RUNTIME_PASSWORD = $credential.GetNetworkCredential().Password
$credential = $null
```

Setup login `helpdesk_setup` chỉ bootstrap database riêng. Schema/tables/functions
thuộc role `helpdesk_owner_<RunId>` NOLOGIN. Backend chỉ dùng
`helpdesk_runtime_<RunId>`: NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOREPLICATION,
NOBYPASSRLS, không role membership, không sở hữu schema/table, không CREATE/TEMP.
PUBLIC không được quyền trên database/schema/tables/functions của demo.
Docker administrators vẫn có thể đọc environment của container; không chia sẻ
`docker inspect` đầy đủ. Script không xuất password hoặc SQL chứa password.

## Preflight và setup

```powershell
.\scripts\helpdesk-local-setup.ps1 -RunId $run
.\scripts\helpdesk-local-setup.ps1 -RunId $run -Execute -ConfirmDemoDatabase $db
```

`-Port` mặc định 55440, host cố định 127.0.0.1; `-Tenant` mặc định `demo`.
Preflight chỉ đọc, không hỏi secret hay tạo tài nguyên. Setup từ chối tên container,
volume hoặc cổng đã tồn tại. Không nhận database/endpoint cloud hay tùy chọn xóa.

SQL dùng từ `backend/src/main/resources/`: Workflow V3, `db/helpdesk/policy-schema.sql`
(bản physical schema V5 độc lập test fixture, chỉ private invoker integrity triggers),
`schema.sql`, `definition.sql`, `runtime-grants.sql`. Không chạy Flyway V1/V2/V4,
`application.sql` cũ hoặc Stage 6 guarded SQL entrypoints. Toàn bộ DDL, definition,
5 states, 4 transitions, tenant, pinned binding `mvp_request -> it-helpdesk@1` và
grants được commit cùng transaction; sealing V3 giữ nguyên. Setup tự kiểm tra
runtime TCP login, inventory, exact DML/column grants và seed sau commit.

Để seed 3 membership/actor, truyền **issuer nguyên văn và `sub` thật** lấy từ
Keycloak/directory đã tin cậy. Phải cung cấp đủ cả ba tài khoản khác nhau:

```powershell
$identity = @{
    KeycloakIssuer = $env:OIDC_ISSUER_URI
    EmployeeSubject = $env:HELPDESK_EMPLOYEE_SUB
    CoordinatorSubject = $env:HELPDESK_COORDINATOR_SUB
    WorkerSubject = $env:HELPDESK_WORKER_SUB
}
.\scripts\helpdesk-local-setup.ps1 -RunId $run -Execute -ConfirmDemoDatabase $db @identity
```

Actor ID được tính đúng như Backend: `oidc:base64url(UTF8(iss)).base64url(UTF8(sub))`,
không padding. Omit toàn bộ identity arguments để chỉ seed tenant/binding, actor và
membership để trống; khi đó chưa thể chạy authenticated demo. Không mặc định tạo
identity giả. Subject khai báo lúc provision **không phải** bằng chứng xác thực.
Keycloak cần issuer/audience/client và client roles đúng contract hiện có:
employee `workflow:create/activate/read/transition` (cần transition để confirm),
coordinator và worker `workflow:read/transition`.
B06 vẫn **NOT VERIFIED** tới khi chạy test với access tokens thật theo runbook B06.

Tên demo là tùy chọn: thêm `-TrustedDemoRealmFile <original-local-realm.json>` khi
setup một database mới. File phải đến từ nguồn provisioning demo đã tin cậy, có
`realm`, và ba `users` với `username` employee-demo/coordinator-demo/worker-demo,
`id` khớp chính xác ba subject đã cung cấp, `firstName`, `lastName` không rỗng.
Issuer phải là loopback và đúng realm của file. Không có file thì tên vẫn NULL;
subject/realm lệch hoặc user trùng bị từ chối trước khi tạo tài nguyên. Không commit
file realm chứa credential. Đây là đối chiếu dữ liệu provisioning, không chứng minh
đăng nhập Keycloak. Không seed lại database bằng chứng đã tồn tại.

Negative HTTP/PostgreSQL dùng `scripts/helpdesk-negative-local.ps1 -RunId <new_id>`:
runner chỉ tạo container/volume mới tại `127.0.0.1:55439/helpdesk_disposable_test`,
từ chối tài nguyên/port có sẵn, sinh credential trong memory và chạy
`HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest`. Test dùng issuer/JWKS tổng hợp và HTTP server ephemeral,
không dùng Keycloak/Backend/BFF đang chạy. Log sanitized nằm trong
`backend/build/closeout-<new_id>/`; container/volume được giữ lại, không tự cleanup.
Kiểm tra provisioning không cần Docker: `scripts/test-helpdesk-local-actor-seed.ps1`.
API list vẫn bỏ tên theo contract hiện có; provisioning chỉ bổ sung tên cho detail.

$env:DXOS_HELPDESK_PASSWORD = $env:HELPDESK_RUNTIME_PASSWORD

param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidatePattern('(?-i)\A[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,23}\z')][string]$RunId)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path
$container = 'dxos-helpdesk-negative-' + $RunId
$volume = $container + '-data'
$database = 'helpdesk_disposable_test'
$image = 'postgres:17.11-alpine'
$evidence = Join-Path $root ('backend/build/closeout-' + $RunId)
function Invoke-NegativeDocker([string[]]$Arguments) {
    $result = & docker --context desktop-linux @Arguments 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('Docker operation failed: ' + $Arguments[0] + '; resources retained') }
    $result
}
$endpoint = (Invoke-NegativeDocker @('context','inspect','desktop-linux','--format','{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') | Out-String).Trim()
if ($endpoint -notmatch '^npipe:/{4}\./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine$') { throw 'Local Docker Desktop Linux required' }
$existingIds = @(Invoke-NegativeDocker @('ps','-aq'))
$metadataFormat = '{{.Id}} {{.Name}} {{.State.StartedAt}} {{.State.Status}} {{.RestartCount}}'
$before = @(Invoke-NegativeDocker (@('inspect','--format',$metadataFormat) + $existingIds))
if (@(Invoke-NegativeDocker @('ps','-a','--format','{{.Names}}')) -contains $container -or
    @(Invoke-NegativeDocker @('volume','ls','--format','{{.Name}}')) -contains $volume -or
    @(Invoke-NegativeDocker @('ps','--filter','publish=55439','--format','{{.ID}}')).Count -gt 0 -or
    @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object LocalPort -eq 55439).Count -gt 0 -or
    (Test-Path -LiteralPath $evidence)) { throw 'Fixture name, volume, port or evidence path already exists; nothing changed' }
$null = Invoke-NegativeDocker @('image','inspect',$image,'--format','{{.Id}}')
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $evidence
$before | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'protected-containers-before.txt')
$saved = @{}
foreach ($name in @('HELPDESK_DISPOSABLE_URL','HELPDESK_DISPOSABLE_PASSWORD','WORKFLOW_EVENT_GUARD_LOCAL_DISPOSABLE',
    'WORKFLOW_TEST_JDBC_URL','B06_EMPLOYEE_ACCESS_TOKEN','B06_COORDINATOR_ACCESS_TOKEN','B06_WORKER_ACCESS_TOKEN')) {
    $saved[$name] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'Process')
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $null, 'Process')
}
$bytes = New-Object byte[] 48
$rng = [Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create()
$rng.GetBytes($bytes)
$rng.Dispose()
$secret = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
[Array]::Clear($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)
try {
    $nonce = [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
    $null = Invoke-NegativeDocker @('volume','create','--label',"dxos.helpdesk.negative=$RunId",'--label',"dxos.helpdesk.instance=$nonce",$volume)
    $volumeInfo = (Invoke-NegativeDocker @('volume','inspect',$volume) | Out-String) | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($volumeInfo[0].Labels.'dxos.helpdesk.instance' -cne $nonce) { throw 'Concurrent volume creation; refusing reuse' }
    # Bootstrap secret travels over stdin into tmpfs, never Docker Config.Env or a host file.
    $startup = 'while [ ! -s /run/secrets/pg_password ]; do sleep 1; done; exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c log_statement=none -c log_min_error_statement=panic'
    $null = Invoke-NegativeDocker @('run','-d','--pull=never','--name',$container,'--label',"dxos.helpdesk.negative=$RunId",
        '-p','127.0.0.1:55439:5432','--mount',"type=volume,source=$volume,target=/var/lib/postgresql/data",
        '--tmpfs','/run/secrets:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=65536',
        '-e',"POSTGRES_DB=$database",'-e','POSTGRES_USER=helpdesk_test',
        '-e','POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/pg_password','-e','POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--auth-host=scram-sha-256',
        '--entrypoint','sh',$image,'-c',$startup)
    $secret | & docker --context desktop-linux exec -i $container sh -c "umask 077; tr -d '\r\n' > /run/secrets/pg_password" 2>&1 | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Secret bootstrap failed; no credential logged' }
    $info = ((Invoke-NegativeDocker @('inspect',$container) | Out-String) | ConvertFrom-Json)[0]
    $binding = @($info.HostConfig.PortBindings.'5432/tcp')
    if ($info.Config.Labels.'dxos.helpdesk.negative' -cne $RunId -or $binding.Count -ne 1 -or
        $binding[0].HostIp -cne '127.0.0.1' -or $binding[0].HostPort -cne '55439' -or
        @($info.Mounts | Where-Object { $_.Type -eq 'volume' -and $_.Name -ceq $volume }).Count -ne 1 -or
        -not $info.HostConfig.Tmpfs.'/run/secrets' -or
        @($info.Config.Env | Where-Object { $_ -like 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=*' }).Count -gt 0) { throw 'Fixture isolation mismatch' }
    $ready = $false
    for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
        $null = & docker --context desktop-linux exec $container pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U helpdesk_test -d $database 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $ready = $true; break }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    }
    if (-not $ready) { throw 'Isolated PostgreSQL not ready; retained without cleanup' }
    $null = Invoke-NegativeDocker @('exec',$container,'sh','-c','rm /run/secrets/pg_password')
    $identity = Invoke-NegativeDocker @('exec',$container,'psql','-X','-w','-At','-U','helpdesk_test','-d',$database,
        '-c',"BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT current_database(),current_setting('server_version_num'); ROLLBACK;")
    if (-not ($identity -match '^helpdesk_disposable_test\|17[0-9]{4}$')) { throw 'Unexpected database or PostgreSQL version' }
    "CONTAINER=$container PORT=127.0.0.1:55439 DATABASE=$database VOLUME=$volume" | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $evidence 'isolation.txt')
    $env:HELPDESK_DISPOSABLE_URL = 'jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:55439/helpdesk_disposable_test'
    $env:HELPDESK_DISPOSABLE_PASSWORD = $secret.Trim()
    $env:WORKFLOW_EVENT_GUARD_LOCAL_DISPOSABLE = 'true'
    Push-Location (Join-Path $root 'backend')
    try {
        $output = & .\gradlew.bat --no-daemon test --tests '*HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest' --console=plain 2>&1
        $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally { Pop-Location }
    $sanitized = ($output | Out-String).Replace($secret, '<REDACTED>')
    $sanitized = $sanitized -replace '(?i)Bearer\s+\S+', 'Bearer <REDACTED>' -replace 'eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]*', '<REDACTED_JWT>'
    $sanitized | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'http-postgres.log') -Encoding UTF8
    $reports = @(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'backend/build/test-results/test') -Filter 'TEST-*HelpdeskHttpPostgresTest.xml')
    if ($reports.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Missing unique HTTP/PostgreSQL test report' }
    foreach ($file in $reports) {
        [xml]$report = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName
        $suite = $report.testsuite
        $cases = @($suite.testcase | ForEach-Object { @{ name=$_.name; time=$_.time; failed=($null -ne $_.failure -or $null -ne $_.error); skipped=($null -ne $_.skipped) } })
        @{ suite=$suite.name; tests=$suite.tests; failures=$suite.failures; errors=$suite.errors; skipped=$suite.skipped; cases=$cases } |
            ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'http-postgres-results.json') -Encoding UTF8
        "TESTS=$($suite.tests) FAILURES=$($suite.failures) ERRORS=$($suite.errors) SKIPPED=$($suite.skipped) EXIT=$testExit"
        foreach ($required in @('fullBootApplicationStartsAndServesGuardedRoutesOverHttp()',
            'trustedLocalProvisioningBindsNamesToExactSubjectsWithoutGrantingAuthority()')) {
            $case = @($cases | Where-Object { $_.name -ceq $required })
            if ($case.Count -ne 1 -or $case[0].failed -or $case[0].skipped) { throw "Required check did not pass: $required" }
        }
    }
    if ($testExit -ne 0) { throw "Tests failed; inspect sanitized log at $evidence" }
} finally {
    foreach ($name in $saved.Keys) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $saved[$name], 'Process') }
    $secret = $null; $output = $null; $sanitized = $null; $info = $null
    $after = @(Invoke-NegativeDocker (@('inspect','--format',$metadataFormat) + $existingIds))
    $after | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'protected-containers-after.txt')
    if (($before -join "`n") -cne ($after -join "`n")) { throw 'Protected container metadata changed; inspect evidence' }
    Write-Output "PROTECTED_CONTAINERS_UNCHANGED=PASS EVIDENCE=$evidence"
}

# APP-10 / APP-11 / APP-13 — bàn giao Application, 26/10/2026

Phạm vi: DX-OS Internal Service Portal của DX-OS Open-Core; IT Helpdesk MVP v0.1. Facility Maintenance tiếp tục MOCK. Không redesign, không thêm CLOSED, không bật LIVE. PASS dưới đây là kết quả kiểm thử Application độc lập với fake service/transport, không phải phê duyệt Backend, Identity hoặc acceptance LIVE.

## 1. Baseline và bảo toàn worktree

- Branch trước/sau: `feature/issue39-university-ui`.
- HEAD trước/sau: `00b10fa43d01cc3dcca725b2ed66a43bdaa92268`.
- Index trước/sau: trống, không có staged changes.
- Ban đầu: 25 tracked modified files, 42 untracked files (13 mục `??` khi Git gộp thư mục), gồm code APP-10/11/13 đã có. Tất cả là baseline, không ghi nhận thành code mới của lượt này.
- Sau lượt này: giữ 25 tracked modified files; 43 untracked files, tăng đúng báo cáo này. Bốn file code/test được bổ sung đều đã untracked từ trước.
- Snapshot SHA-256 trước khi sửa gồm 285 tracked/untracked files. Đối chiếu sau: không mất file; chỉ bốn file liệt kê ở mục 6 đổi bytes. 281 file có sẵn còn lại giữ nguyên, bao gồm toàn bộ tracked modified, hai ảnh evidence đã modified, Backend/Core/Identity/Gateway/Database và các tài liệu cũ.
- Bản hash/status/diff ban đầu và bản sao bốn file trước sửa: `%TEMP%/dxos-app-10-11-13-before/`.
- Không commit, push, merge, rebase, stash, reset, clean; không xóa file chưa commit.

## 2. Xác minh Backend contract

Đã đọc metadata PR #63 qua GitHub connector: draft/open, HEAD chính xác `e12d105c89400a5fd69dd6cc1fca670ff1f04f51`. Commit này chưa có trong object database local; không dùng source Backend ở checkout cũ để mapping, không checkout/fetch đè worktree.

Đã đọc hai source tại exact SHA:

- [HelpdeskController.java](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/blob/e12d105c89400a5fd69dd6cc1fca670ff1f04f51/backend/src/main/java/com/tricore/dxos/gateway/helpdesk/HelpdeskController.java), blob `20facd7df094080311714dffb16dd8403f5cf0f3`.
- [HelpdeskService.java](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/blob/e12d105c89400a5fd69dd6cc1fca670ff1f04f51/backend/src/main/java/com/tricore/dxos/infrastructure/workflow/HelpdeskService.java), blob `51ce0a3318f41f6a33a4e8ea929b2acc696a59c8`.

`RequestView` có Workflow state/version authoritative, `assignmentVersion` riêng. Names/eligible list là Detail enrichment; list và mutation không cung cấp enrichment này. ## Run v0.1.0

### Option A — MOCK Portal (quick UI demonstration)

Requires Node.js **22.12.0 or newer**, npm, and a browser. From the repository root:

```powershell
Set-Location frontend
npm.cmd ci
npm.cmd run dev
```

Open [http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173). This uses in-memory demonstration data and **does not require a backend, PostgreSQL, credentials, or live SSO**. Return to the repository root with `Set-Location ..`. On macOS/Linux use `npm` instead of `npm.cmd`.

### Option B — Local PostgreSQL Helpdesk environment

Follow the [local Helpdesk runbook](scripts/README-helpdesk-local.md) from the repository root and use the [isolated setup script](scripts/helpdesk-local-setup.ps1). It requires Windows PowerShell, Docker Desktop Linux Engine, JDK 21 and free demo ports. Run the script's **read-only preflight** before opting into creation of an isolated PostgreSQL 17 demo database; do not run its `-Execute` step against existing resources. The runbook covers required secrets, real identity subject provisioning and backend startup.

### Option C — `integration-local` Portal (configured local stack)

Requires **Node.js >=22.12**, npm, **JDK 21**, Docker Desktop/PostgreSQL 17, a configured **real Keycloak OIDC client**, Backend, Portal BFF, and **Caddy HTTPS ingress** with a browser-trusted local certificate. Follow the [Portal BFF local setup](portal-bff/README.md) and the [Helpdesk local runbook](scripts/README-helpdesk-local.md); provision the exact issuer, three real subjects, database roles and BFF client secrets before claiming an authenticated run.

From the repository root, build the distinct integration bundle:

```powershell
Set-Location frontend
npm.cmd ci
npm.cmd run build:integration-local
Set-Location ..
```

Start Backend, BFF and the configured local HTTPS ingress **following the BFF runbook** (including its Caddy configuration); a build alone does not start any server. Only **after** those prerequisites are running and the certificate is trusted, open [https://localhost:8443/mvp/helpdesk](https://localhost:8443/mvp/helpdesk). The integration build uses the BFF's `/bff/session` boundary and real OIDC redirects instead of the MOCK demo-persona flow. Verify in the browser that the Helpdesk page is served by the HTTPS origin, `/bff/session` is reachable, and login requires actual Keycloak authentication. If the BFF or provider is not configured, a 502 or failed login is **not** a successful LIVE run.

**Mode distinction:** Option A (`npm.cmd run dev`) serves synthetic, in-memory MOCK requests at `http://127.0.0.1:5173`. Option C (`npm.cmd run build:integration-local`) creates an integration bundle for HTTPS/BFF hosting, but **R12 fresh-clone and authenticated browser E2E remain unverified** until recorded separately.

## Known limitations

- The MOCK Portal is a demonstration, not a live application or security acceptance.
- The full Keycloak/PKCE browser login, three-persona Helpdesk E2E flow and clean-install release acceptance require R12 evidence.
- Facility workflow runtime reuse, APISIX edge runtime, MinIO storage and production deployment are not claimed as completed v0.1.0 features.
- Focused PostgreSQL 17 R10 passed with two documented skips; deferred database/provider audits and third-party SPDX/license review are tracked separately.

# DX-OS Open-Core
**Reusable Digital Capabilities for Internal Service Applications**
DX-OS Open-Core is TRICORE's modular monolith for exploring reusable capabilities behind internal service applications. The Internal Service Portal / IT Support scenario is the main demonstration target. DX-OS is a digital transformation platform concept, not a computer operating system or a claim about the competition's required product.
**Source baseline:** `origin/main` at `2115de3`. This README describes that source snapshot; work on unmerged branches and pull requests is identified separately.
**Navigate:** [Overview](#overview) · [Architecture](#architecture-overview) · [Status](#implementation-status) · [Getting started](#getting-started) · [Documentation](#documentation-and-verification) · [License](#license-and-third-party-notices)
## Overview
Internal service requests often arrive through email, paper, spreadsheets, phone calls, or messaging apps. Scattered channels make ownership, progress, and decision history difficult to track. The proposed Portal brings request submission, assignment, processing, and status into one application.

DX-OS aims to supply reusable technical mechanisms for that application and others. An IT Support request may move from submission through review, assignment, resolution, requester confirmation, and closure. The application defines those business steps and permissions; Core supplies mechanisms that can be reused. This is TRICORE's demonstration scenario, not an assertion that OLP PMNM 2026 mandates this product.

## Why DX-OS?

The intended reuse boundary separates shared mechanisms from application-specific rules:

| Capability | Core responsibility | Application responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identity / SSO | Principal, authentication context, and authority contracts | Business roles and request-specific permissions |
| API Gateway | API entry point, routing, trusted-context boundary, and error handling | User-facing business operations |
| Workflow | Definitions, instances, transitions, versions, history, and state safeguards | Business states, transitions, and conditions |
| Data Management | Persistence and storage contracts with provider adapters | Business data, ownership, and retention rules |

The Portal is a demonstration interface, while the Request package is an application/business prototype. Neither defines the reusable Workflow Core. IT Support and Facility/Access Request could use the same Workflow mechanisms with different business lifecycles; demonstrating that reuse remains an acceptance goal, not a completed end-to-end integration claim.

## Architecture Overview

The backend uses Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.5.16 as a **modular monolith**. Its logical boundaries do not imply separately deployed microservices. The diagram shows intended responsibilities and dependency direction:
External client / application
            |
            v
    API Gateway boundary
       /          \
      v            v
 Identity       Application
 contracts         layer
                     |
                     v
                Workflow Core
                     |
                     v
         WorkflowPersistencePort
                     |
                     v
        Data / persistence adapter
                     |
                     v
                 PostgreSQL
This is an architecture view, not evidence that the full Gateway → Identity → Portal → Workflow → database path is integrated. Workflow owns `WorkflowPersistencePort`; a Data adapter can implement it without redefining Workflow semantics. Workflow does not own IT Support-specific rules, and Gateway does not own business workflows or persistence. Client-supplied identity headers are not trusted merely because they reached an HTTP boundary.
See the [architecture baseline](docs/architecture/README.md) and [Core contracts](docs/contracts/).
## Core Capabilities
- **Identity / SSO:** Core identity and authorization contracts exist. Complete SSO/OIDC enforcement through Gateway is not established in the stated main baseline.
- **API Gateway:** API boundary code exists, but the generic Workflow HTTP adapter is not registered as a production endpoint in this baseline. Trusted caller propagation and protection require separate evidence.
- **Workflow:** Generic definitions, instances, transitions by transition ID, exact definition-version binding, optimistic concurrency, history, terminal-state safeguards, and a persistence port have code and tests. Application-specific Request workflow remains separate.
- **Data Management:** Object-storage contracts and Workflow persistence work exist. A complete object-storage provider and release-level PostgreSQL behavior are not established by those contracts alone.
## Implementation Status
The table describes **`origin/main` at `2115de3`**, inspected on October 22, 2026. It is a source snapshot, not a test run performed on that date.
| Area | Present in the baseline | Still to verify or complete |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow Core | Contracts, runtime, version binding, history, persistence port, and related tests | Full Portal integration and release acceptance |
| Identity Core | Principal, context, authority, and decision contracts | End-to-end SSO/OIDC protection on main |
| Data Core | Object-storage contracts and Workflow persistence mechanisms | Complete storage provider and reviewed live behavior |
| Gateway / API | Request HTTP endpoints and API boundary code | Protected generic Workflow HTTP registration and trusted-context path |
| Request prototype | Separate application code and tests | Integration with generic Workflow Core |
| Frontend Portal | Demonstration direction and work outside the main baseline | A merged, verified Portal release |
| PostgreSQL / Flyway | Configuration and migrations V1–V4 | Startup, privileges, rollback, and live-environment acceptance evidence |
Identity–Gateway integration, the Portal, a complete demonstration, proof of Core reuse across two applications, and reproducible release packaging require their own reviewed evidence. An unmerged PR or roadmap item is not a capability already available on main.

On **October 7, 2026**, at commit **`2b51a41`**, project documentation recorded **29 Workflow tests, 109 Request tests, and 139 backend tests**, with a successful build. The commands, environment, and limits are in the [Workflow POC](docs/poc/workflow-core-poc.md). These are historical results, **not** test counts or results from October 22.
At that checkpoint, [Workflow Core Issue #13](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/issues/13) was closed through [PR #15](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/pull/15); [Identity Issue #12](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/issues/12) and [Data Issue #14](https://github.com/lexuanbao258-collab/dxos-open-core/issues/14) were open. Mock, fake, and MVC-slice tests do not by themselves establish PostgreSQL transactions, live security enforcement, or a complete Portal demonstration.

Diagram dưới đây là hướng phụ thuộc mục tiêu, không khẳng định toàn bộ luồng
đã tích hợp hoặc các thành phần được triển khai thành service riêng.

```text
External / H-P-D-I Application
             |
             v
         API Gateway
          /      \
         v        v
   Identity      Workflow
                   |
                   v
        WorkflowPersistencePort
                   |
                   v
          Data / Persistence
```

| Capability | Trách nhiệm |
| --- | --- |
| Identity / SSO | Authentication, identity resolution, authority information và authentication/security context tin cậy |
| API Gateway | External entry point, routing, xử lý public/protected routes, phối hợp Identity, truyền trusted context và chuẩn hóa lỗi tại boundary |
| Workflow | Definition/instance tái sử dụng, transition bằng transitionId, exact definition version binding, runtime versioning, optimistic concurrency, history và bảo vệ terminal state |
| Data Management | Boundary persistence dữ liệu có cấu trúc, boundary object storage tương lai, provider adapters và triển khai persistence cho port do Core capability sở hữu |

Gateway không sở hữu persistence hay ngữ nghĩa workflow nghiệp vụ. Workflow
không gọi Identity trực tiếp tại runtime. `WorkflowPersistencePort` thuộc Workflow;
Data có thể triển khai adapter sau này nhưng không định nghĩa lại Workflow semantics
hoặc phụ thuộc ngược lên application/consumer. Xem [baseline kiến trúc](docs/architecture/README.md).

Request và workflow IT Support trong `com.tricore.dxos.request` hiện là
application/business prototype, có API và persistence riêng. Generic Workflow
Core đã triển khai riêng; Request chưa được chuyển sang Core mới.
